# Native build dependencies for comma 3 (tici) on AGNOS 12.6.
#
# 0.11.2 gets these from comma-deps-* wheels installed into the device venv.
# AGNOS 12.6 predates that, so we install them repo-locally with
# `pip install --target c3_third_party` and put that dir first on PYTHONPATH
# (see launch_chffrplus.sh). SConstruct imports each by bare module name and
# reads INCLUDE_DIR / LIB_DIR from it, so real wheels work unmodified.
#
# Must cover every entry in SConstruct's pkg_names.
comma-deps-acados
comma-deps-bzip2
comma-deps-capnproto
comma-deps-catch2
comma-deps-eigen
comma-deps-ffmpeg
comma-deps-json11
comma-deps-ncurses
comma-deps-zeromq
comma-deps-zstd

# raylib 6.0 + its pyray binding. AGNOS 12.6's venv has raylib-python-cffi
# 5.5.0.2, whose LoadFontData takes 6 args; 0.11.2 calls it with 7.
comma-deps-raylib

# USB panda support on C3 (see selfdrive/pandad, C3_USB_FIRST)
comma-deps-libusb

# dbus, imported by the runtime
jeepney
